correctness.rationale: For a birth rate ell*n+u, death rate (1+zeta)*n and reset-to-zero rate r, the generator gives (a+r)M1=u and (2a+r)M2=2(ell+u)M1, a=1+zeta-ell. After multiplication by the number of sites and the stated ordered continuum limit this yields the exact integral for the within-site ordered pair density. The known first-moment closure stays bounded for 0<nu<1 when beta<1/B0. Endpoint comparison gives finite pairs for nu<1/2, 4/C^2 times log(1/zeta) at nu=1/2, and 2*C^(-1/nu)*zeta^(1/nu-2)*integral_0^infty[(1+x^nu)(2+x^nu)]^-1 dx for nu>1/2; a beta integral evaluates the amplitude. A 32-assertion independent finite-generator/quadrature checker passed, but is supplemental to the analytic proof.
